answers.core: Well, I'm certain that I'm not the only person who would like this option. As Godot becomes more fleshed out, I think that people might expect this. If it is an addon, *or* if it's already there, and I'm just overlooking this, it's a great feature nonetheless.
answers.workaround: I don't know if it can be worked around with a few lines of script. I do know that I can change the translation of the object in my scene to kind of simulate being closes to it. But, that's not ideal and has a lot of rework involved.
